items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: this is Irving Bower or whatever his name is you know, and he’s got a board and he’s writing down things

ctx.x: Yeah, but I want to hear how this worked.

And then you’d be hanging out there just so you’d get your face known you know. And the musicians would take you by the hand and they’d lead you around and this is Irving Bower or whatever his name is you know, and he’s got a board and he’s writing down things and he says, “You know all the tunes?” And then you’re supposed to say yes, you know. Some people would say no. Some people would say all but one.
Hope they don’t call that one.
